name: the Wyld Boyz
caption: A tag team that won a non-title bout over the Depth of Darkness on the promotion's own 4 October 1997 broadcast.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Hardcore Saturday Night broadcasts.

name: the Depth of Darkness
caption: A tag team beaten by the Wyld Boyz on the promotion's own 4 October 1997 broadcast.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Hardcore Saturday Night broadcasts.

name: Storm Inc.
caption: The promotion's own reigning Tag Team Champions by December 1997, awarded a win over the Brooklyn Brawlers when that team refused to compete a fourth time.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Hardcore Saturday Night broadcasts.

name: the Brooklyn Brawlers
caption: A tag team, accompanied by the Slutty Slasher, that refused to face the champions Storm Inc. a fourth time on the promotion's own 13 December 1997 broadcast.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Hardcore Saturday Night broadcasts.
